feed.title: Propagation Delay and Mining Centralization: Modeling Stale Rates

entry.title: Propagation Delay and Mining Centralization: Modeling Stale Rates
entry.summary:
A recent update to the mining simulation project has introduced 2026 values and incorporated bug fixes contributed by Fable. These enhancements are now available in the [mining simulation repository](https://github.com/darosior/miningsimulation), providing users with more accurate and current data for their analyses.
The README documentation has been expanded to offer a deeper examination of how stale rates affect mining profits. This addition delivers valuable insights into the relationship between network conditions and profitability, equipping miners and researchers with relevant information for decision-making and strategy development.
There is ongoing consideration regarding the extension of the simulation model to account for internal delays. Modeling these internal delays would enable analysis of potential efficiency gains from adopting Stratum V2 (SV2), an emerging protocol that has attracted recent attention within the mining community. Further discussion on this subject can be found in the related [issue thread](https://github.com/darosior/miningsimulation/issues/2).
